reconstruction.heightBasis: Mapped nominal heights20/24m and min_height20/24 to height34 for the two main domes; bell30m, eastern apse23m and western roof turret22m. All heights are relative to the common estimated native church floor0.75m. Untagged roofs/ranges/terraces, front cupolas, portal/window details and precise slope/contact levels are picture-led estimates.
reconstruction.scope: Connected church exterior: two principal domes/drums, square bell tower, arched south facade/entrance court, mapped upper/low ranges, selected small cupolas/apse roofs and terrace stairs. Interior Aedicule/chapels, below-grade StHelena volume, separate east police range, surrounding city and exact sculpture remain excluded.
reconstruction.componentControlMethod: Union of all current standard PMTiles fragments for each selected ID; higher part footprints mask lower roof caps. Interior/underground and separate east range are excluded from visible reconstruction.
